finalText:
**Migrated 12 files, 36 call sites, to `db.execute({ sql, params })`.** No `db.query` left in app code.

Left alone: `[vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js:9](vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js:9)`. Its header says do not edit. It is replaced on every upgrade. Local edits get lost.

Note that `cache.query` is a different API. I did not touch it.

Next: keep `db.query` in `[lib/db.js:13](lib/db.js:13)` until the vendor drop lands.
